name: An 870-Concept Rooted Factor with a Nonisometric Sink Set
definition: For the normalized 289-concept rooted core $C$, put $A=C\cup\{128\}$ and $B=C\cup\{290\}$ and form $S=\{0\}\cup\{4x+2:x\in A\}\cup\{4x+1:x\in B\}\cup\{4x+3:x\in C\}$, rooted at $0$.
properties: $(S,0)$ is an ample rooted factor. Vertices $1$ and $2$ are attainable peeling endpoints, while $0$ and $3$ are not. Since $1$ and $2$ have Hamming distance two and their only common ambient-cube neighbours are $0$ and $3$, the induced graph on $\operatorname{Sink}(S)$ is not isometric and hence is not ample.
